// @path: src/lib/ops/stripeLinks.ts
// @expect: OPS-IMPORT-ALLOWLIST
// The near miss the PR3 widening invites. @/lib/stripeMode is on the allowlist
// because it is two booleans over one environment variable. @/lib/stripe is
// NOT, and must never be: it builds the Stripe SDK client from the secret key,
// so permitting it would put getStripe() one keystroke from every operator
// screen and the "ops links out, never calls out" property would rest on nobody
// typing it.
import { getStripe, stripeLiveMode } from "@/lib/stripe";

export function customerLink(id) {
  const mode = stripeLiveMode() ? "" : "/test";
  getStripe();
  return `https://dashboard.stripe.com${mode}/customers/${id}`;
}
